dna.thesis: Ilo becomes a tall, black-and-silver folk wanderer in a pointed soft hat, carrying an accordion-pleated paper lantern with a silver-blue flame, who walks the cliff road with a slow, majestic sea-legged roll and kindles the beacon with an operatic, singing gesture.

devices.device: Black-and-silver wanderer's coat with faded rust and moss folk accents
devices.translation: My interpretation: the returned black-and-silver palette tag becomes the main masses (near-black coat and hat, silver hair, trim, buttons and pleated collar); the lo-fi folk tag adds two faded, home-dyed accents, a rust sash and lantern ribs and a moss bedroll; the neutral palette tag keeps everything else desaturated. No logo or team mark is used.

devices.device: Tall, narrow figure under a pointed soft folk hat whose tip bends back in the wind, over a long coat whose skirt and tail flow behind
devices.translation: My interpretation: the folk-fantasy and witch tags become an original pointed, wide-brimmed soft hat with a sprung, bent tip (not any film costume); the fluid-silhouettes tag becomes one continuous outline from hat tip to a flared coat skirt with a trailing coat tail. The figure grows tall and slim, so the head and hat take a smaller share than a big-headed design.

devices.device: Accordion-pleated paper bellows lantern and a matching pleated silver collar
devices.translation: My interpretation: the accordion tag becomes the lantern's construction, a hanging paper lantern folded like bellows with rust ribs and caps; the sculptural-designs tag turns the same zigzag fold into a stiff pleated collar at the neck, so the light and the costume share one folded form.

devices.device: Road kit of a working adventurer: moss bedroll on the back, a rust shoulder strap and a knotted sash
devices.translation: My interpretation: the adventurer tags become plain travelling gear rather than weapons (Ilo has no combat ability): a rolled moss blanket tied to the back, a strap crossing the chest and a sash whose tail blows in the wind; the craftsmanship tag shows in visible ties and stitched cuffs.

devices.device: Slow, upright, majestic walk with a rolling sea-legged hip sway and a deliberate pivot turn
devices.translation: My interpretation: majestic sets a slow cadence, almost no bounce, a chest held slightly back and a level head; nautical adds a sailor's rolling hip sway above the sea of cloud and a full free swing of the empty arm, while the lantern arm is carried out in front; the turn is an unhurried pivot.

devices.device: Operatic kindling: Ilo leans back, lifts the head as if holding a sung note, raises the bellows lantern overhead and opens the other arm before releasing the flame
devices.translation: My interpretation: operatic and singer become a long, swelling gesture with a held peak: a slow rise over 2.3 seconds, the flame leaving at the top like the last note, then a long settle; silver-blue motes burst at the release.

devices.device: Silver-blue enchanted flame glowing through pale pleated paper, with motes drifting up from it
devices.translation: My interpretation: enchanting becomes a cool, moonlit silver-blue flame instead of a plain warm lamp, so the beacon and far towers answer in an uncanny pale light, with a slow flicker and a few motes rising from the lantern.

devices.device: Moody, earnest, devoted lines: short plain sentences with a ragged emotional catch
devices.translation: My interpretation: moody and character-study set an inward, observational register; emotive and devoted give each line a plain, unguarded promise to the road and the beacon. The words are my own, quoting nothing.

lines: Cold wind off the cloud sea. I hold the lantern close, like a promise I made to no one in particular.
I won't turn back, keeper. I didn't walk all this way to stop at a bridge.
Wake now, Vesper. I carried this light the whole long road for you.
They are. One by one. Let me sit with you a while before I walk on.

devices.device: Austere, somber portrait: a lone tall figure in black and silver on a bare basalt ledge, lit only by a small silver-blue lantern
devices.translation: My interpretation: visually austere and somber direct a sparse composition with a flat dusk sky, few shapes and one small cold light source.
